CreateAnInstance.clientToken: Idempotency token, an ASCII string of no more than 64 characters.
CreateAnInstance.billing.reservation: Reservation information. Not required for Postpaid; required for Prepaid.
CreateAnInstance.instanceName: User-defined instance name. Requirements: 1) Supports uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, Chinese characters, and special characters such as - _ / .; must start with a letter or a Chinese character. 2) Length must be 1-64.
CreateAnInstance.nodeType: Instance specification. Required for Redis memory type and Redis capacity type. Get specific specifications via the Get Instance Specification List API. Optional and invalid for Memcache.
CreateAnInstance.port: Port number, selectable from 1025-7041, 7043-22221, or 22223-65534; can be changed after creation.
CreateAnInstance.engine: Engine type, default is 2. Redis memory type: 2; Redis capacity type: 3.
CreateAnInstance.engineVersion: Database version: Redis enterprise cluster edition: 4.0, 5.0, 6.0; Redis community standard edition: 4.0, 5.0, 6.0, 7.0.
CreateAnInstance.storeType: Storage type, default is 0. High-performance memory: 0; capacity storage: 3.
CreateAnInstance.enableReadOnly: Replica read-only, default is 2. Enable: 1; disable: 2.
CreateAnInstance.proxyNum: Number of proxy nodes. Currently supported values: master-slave edition: 0; cluster edition: number of proxy nodes = number of shards; when the cluster edition has 1 shard, the number of proxy nodes is 2.
CreateAnInstance.clusterType: Cluster type: enterprise cluster edition: "cluster"; master-slave edition: "master_slave".
CreateAnInstance.diskFlavor: Storage space per shard. Provided when engine type is 3, i.e., Redis capacity type (formerly PegaDB).
CreateAnInstance.vpcId: vpcId. Belongs to the default VPC if not provided. Query available VPCs via the Query VPC List API. If this parameter is provided, the replicationInfo field is required, and the subnets in the replica information must belong to this vpcId.
CreateAnInstance.replicationInfo: Replica information. Provide as many items as the number of replicas to create; each item represents one replica. Availability zone and subnet ownership must be consistent. Subnet and vpcId ownership must be consistent. There must be exactly one master node. Redis and Redis capacity type support up to 10 replicas. Redis cluster edition and Redis capacity type require at least 2 replicas; Redis standard edition supports a single replica. Availability zone and subnet can only be in a one-to-one relationship.
CreateAnInstance.replicationInfo.availabilityZone: Query the availability zone list via the Get Availability Zone List API. The zoneName naming convention is "country-region-zone sequence" in lowercase, e.g., Beijing Zone A is "cn-bj-a".
CreateAnInstance.replicationInfo.isMaster: Whether it is the master node: 1 for master, 0 for slave. There must be exactly one master node.
CreateAnInstance.autoRenewTimeUnit: Monthly or yearly billing: "month" for month, "year" for year.
CreateAnInstance.autoRenewTime: Auto-renewal duration: 1-9 for monthly, 1-3 for yearly.
CreateAnInstance.bgwGroupId: BLB dedicated cluster ID. If not provided, defaults to a shared cluster.
CreateAnInstance.clientAuth: Password of 8-16 characters, containing at least two of the following: letters, digits, and special characters. Allowed special characters include $^*()_+-=. The password must be transmitted encrypted; plaintext transmission is prohibited. See the Password Encryption Transmission Specification for details.
CreateAnInstance.resourceGroupId: Resource group ID. Resource group information can be queried via the Resource Management API.
CreateAnInstance.autoBackupConfig: Backup configuration. Format: "${backup cycle};${backup time};${backup duration}". Backup cycle values: Monday: 'Mon', Tuesday: 'Tue', Wednesday: 'Wed', Thursday: 'Thu', Friday: 'Fri', Saturday: 'Sta', Sunday: 'Sun'. Backup time is in UTC, e.g., 16:00:00 corresponds to 00:00:00 Beijing time. Backup time: value 1-15.
CreateAnInstance.deployIdList: Deployment set ID list. It is recommended to provide only one deployment set ID, i.e., the list length must not exceed 1. Get the deployment set ID via the Deployment Set List API.
